candidates.title: City station readings (hourly)
candidates.why_relevant: Hourly NO2 and PM2.5 readings from the city's own monitoring stations at hourly grain — exactly what N1 needs for the production window. Covers 2023-01-01 onward so covers 2024-2025 production period. Columns: station_id, ts_utc, no2_ugm3, pm25_ugm3. Units documented in µg/m³.
candidates.found_via: search_internal_catalog('Valdena air quality monitoring station hourly readings')
suspected_issues: Station VR-03 (Via Roma) was switched off on 2024-06-30; catalog still lists it as active (wiki: station_network)
No PM10 or O3 available — only NO2 and PM2.5
Temporal coverage starts 2023-01-01, does NOT cover prototype window (2004-2005)
Access requires request to Environment Monitoring Unit — is a data-sharing agreement needed?

candidates.title: Road traffic counts (hourly)
candidates.why_relevant: Hourly vehicle counts by road counters near the monitoring stations — covers N2 production window. Temporal coverage from 2021-01-01 onward, so covers 2024-2025. Columns: counter_id, ts_local, vehicles.
candidates.found_via: search_internal_catalog('Valdena traffic sensor hourly counts near air quality station')
suspected_issues: On 2024-03-18 road counters were replaced; before that counts per direction, after that both directions combined — breaks comparability (wiki: counter_replacement_2024)
Catalog entry has no note about this change — a pipeline would need to detect and adjust
Access requires request to Mobility Office — separate data-sharing agreement likely needed
No geolocation data in columns — unclear proximity to air quality stations

candidates.title: Respiratory visits (daily, by district)
candidates.why_relevant: Daily respiratory clinic visit counts by district, no patient identifiers — directly meets N4. Temporal coverage from 2022-01-01, so covers 2024-2025 production window. Columns: visit_date, district, visit_count.
candidates.found_via: search_internal_catalog('Valdena clinic respiratory visit daily counts by district')
suspected_issues: Clinic data policy explicitly permits this table for surveillance — good
District boundaries may have changed during the production window (unknown)
Weekend/holiday effects may produce zero counts that look like missing data
Respiratory coding consistency across clinics unknown

candidates.title: Clinic visits (one row per patient visit)
candidates.why_relevant: Patient-level visit records with diagnosis codes — would serve N5 at event grain. Columns: patient_key, visit_ts, age_band, postcode, diagnosis_code.
candidates.found_via: search_internal_catalog('Valdena clinic patient visit records respiratory')
suspected_issues: Clinic data policy explicitly states patient-level records may NOT be used for this analysis (wiki: clinic_data_policy, last_edited 2025-02-01)
Contains PII (pseudonymised patient key, age_band, postcode) — special category data under GDPR
Access requires Data Protection Office approval — not granted for this use case
Business brief states individual patient records are out of scope

candidates.title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis)
candidates.why_relevant: Free ERA5 reanalysis API providing hourly temperature_2m and relative_humidity_2m. Covers both windows (2004-2005 and 2024-2025) at any lat/lon. Registered in the register (api.open_meteo_archive) with agreement_status 'not_required_open_data' and approved for prototyping and production.
suspected_issues: Default coordinates in register (Lisbon 38.72, -9.14) are NOT the client's location — must choose northern Italy coordinates (human decision needed)
ERA5 reanalysis is ~9 km grid resolution — point coordinates are grid-cell averages
Register entry only has default query with temperature_2m and shortwave_radiation — need to verify relative_humidity_2m is available
API may have rate limits for multi-year queries

candidates.title: Nager.Date public holidays API
candidates.why_relevant: Provides public holiday dates for Italy — useful for interpreting zero/low clinic visit counts on holidays/weekends in N4. Registered in the register with 'not_required_open_data' status, approved for prototyping and production.
suspected_issues: Supplementary — does not directly provide clinic visit data but helps validate N4 completeness
Holiday API may not cover regional/local holidays relevant to Valdena

candidates.title: AtmosData Pro station-grade weather feed
candidates.why_relevant: Station-grade weather data that could have provided hourly temperature and humidity — but agreement has expired. Included as a finding so Risk Assessor can see it.
suspected_issues: Agreement expired (AD-2021-114 ran 2022-01-01 to 2025-12-31, renewal pending Procurement)
API key revoked 2026-01-01
No approved purposes listed (empty array)
Cannot be used until renewal is signed — Open-Meteo is the fallback

unmet_needs: N1 (prototype window 2004-2005): No internal source covers this period. Internal city station data starts 2023. The search plan identifies the UCI Machine Learning Repository 'Air Quality' dataset (hourly pollutant concentrations from an Italian city, March 2004–April 2005) as the only known candidate. Human must supply this as a dataset link and confirm the location matches northern Italy. Also consider ARPA regional open data portals and EEA air quality data portal as potential links.

N5 (patient-level clinic visits): Clinic data policy (wiki: clinic_data_policy, last_edited 2025-02-01) explicitly prohibits use of clinic.patient_visits for this analysis. The business brief states individual patient records are out of scope. No viable candidate.

N6 (Italy annual PM2.5 attributable deaths): No internal source found. Candidates are external open datasets: WHO Global Health Observatory (annual deaths attributable to ambient PM2.5, Italy), EEA health impacts reports, and ISTAT annual mortality statistics by cause. Human must supply these as dataset links. Note: these are modelled estimates with typically 2-3 year publication lag, so 2024-2025 data may not yet be available.
